description: This is a 3D model of a kotatsu table, a low wooden table frame covered by a heavy blanket or throw, upon which a tabletop is placed. Underneath the tabletop is a heat source, usually an electric heater attached to the frame. It is a common feature of Japanese homes during the winter months. The image shows a square table with a dark surface and two lighter rectangular inserts, covered by a deep red blanket draped over the sides. The table is placed on a light brown, textured mat.
